python3 << 'PYEOF'
import zipfile, shutil, re, os

src = '/home/user/Desktop/Y22-2119-assign4.docx'
tmp = '/tmp/Y22-2119-assign4.modified.docx'

# Read the document.xml
with zipfile.ZipFile(src, 'r') as zin:
    names = zin.namelist()
    doc_xml = zin.read('word/document.xml').decode('utf-8')

# For every <w:rPr>...</w:rPr> that contains <w:i w:val="1"/>, replace size 24 -> 28
def fix_rpr(m):
    rpr = m.group(0)
    if re.search(r'<w:i\s+w:val="1"\s*/>', rpr) or re.search(r'<w:i\s*/>', rpr):
        rpr = re.sub(r'<w:sz w:val="24"/>', '<w:sz w:val="28"/>', rpr)
        rpr = re.sub(r'<w:szCs w:val="24"/>', '<w:szCs w:val="28"/>', rpr)
    return rpr

new_xml, n = re.subn(r'<w:rPr>.*?</w:rPr>', fix_rpr, doc_xml)
print(f'Processed {n} rPr elements')

# Count how many italic rPrs got the size change
italic_28 = len(re.findall(r'<w:rPr>(?:(?!</w:rPr>).)*<w:i\s+w:val="1"\s*/>(?:(?!</w:rPr>).)*<w:sz w:val="28"/>', new_xml))
italic_24 = len(re.findall(r'<w:rPr>(?:(?!</w:rPr>).)*<w:i\s+w:val="1"\s*/>(?:(?!</w:rPr>).)*<w:sz w:val="24"/>', new_xml))
print(f'Italic rPrs now at sz=28: {italic_28}; still at sz=24: {italic_24}')

# Write new docx, copying all other entries
with zipfile.ZipFile(src, 'r') as zin, zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for item in zin.infolist():
        data = zin.read(item.filename)
        if item.filename == 'word/document.xml':
            data = new_xml.encode('utf-8')
        zout.writestr(item, data)

shutil.move(tmp, src)
print(f'Saved {src}, size={os.path.getsize(src)} bytes')
PYEOF
